items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: the McCalls, the people that we raised

ctx.x: See, because my brother, see the McCall, the people that we raised, he got married I think in 1900. I remember driving him to the station. My brother? No. The McCalls, the people that we raised, the sons. See I had to go with them to drive the buggy back, because they got to trade and they go to New Orleans. And I went after they got settled, about 1901. They were in Mardi Gras. See my brother was in New Orleans, he was in New Orleans about a year from when my mother met there.
